data.summary:
This unit can join a unit led by an **INQUISITOR**:

- when your Army Faction is anything other than **AGENTS OF THE IMPERIUM**, every distinct pairing in your army of 1 **INQUISITORIAL AGENTS** unit with 1 **DAEMONHOST** unit raises your army's limit on **RETINUE** units by 1
- as the Declare Battle Formations step starts, this unit may join 1 **INQUISITORIAL AGENTS** unit of yours that an **INQUISITOR** model is leading, and no unit may have more than 1 **DAEMONHOST** unit joined to it
- once joined, its models count as part of that **Bodyguard** unit until the battle ends, and that unit's **Starting Strength** rises to match
